long_biography.plain_text:
An unexpected stream of charter enquiries transformed Paris Dragnis's first large-vessel construction project into a business model. A short charter season covered its annual costs, prompting progressively larger projects and a dedicated construction company.

Dragnis brought decades of commercial shipowning experience into the yard, adding in-house engineering and project teams before moving new construction to Greece. The shipbuilding company combined building and refit capabilities with charter and management services. He remained directly engaged with new projects, sometimes forming ideas overnight and taking them to the project team the following morning for discussion.
